name: Hunan Development Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Hunan Development Group Co., Ltd. engages in the investment, development, construction, operation, and management of hydropower and photovoltaic power generation in China. The company is involved in developing and sale of river sand, river pebbles, crushed stones, and other products; and equity investment business; operation of distribution centers. Hunan Development Group Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Changsha, China.
